observations.summary: Red selector/inclusion/global and compiler evidence; 15 node tests, both strict compilers, identity receipt and 20 real browser property cases passed. Direct assertion review preserved render/undo behavior. See tmp/ten-step1-*.

Independent coordinate-corruption red proof; real clock barrier asserts zero frames and stale display across canonical successor clicks, then catch-up. 26 Pen browser and 12 owner cases, strict compiler and document guards passed. See tmp/ten-step2-*.
Five owner red cases and locked-target real browser red. Shared policy passes nine owner cases, 14 browser deletion/history/reload cases, 14 doc/entry cases, types and naming. See tmp/ten-step3-*.

Real overlay registration rejects old scale/pan reuse; actual draw calls now match projected endpoints and empty/repeated states. Six focused cases and 20 selection/viewport browser cases passed. See tmp/ten-step4-*.

Reviewed authoritative replacement/lifetime contract, malformed inputs, order/workspace invalidation and live selection/modifiers. 54 consumer cases, final 30 owner cases, 7 hierarchy browser cases and strict compilers passed. Combined browser acceptance remains separate and open; see plan.

Prior bounded R1-R10 and rectangle acceptance is retained. Additional O/P/V/T proof: 8 new real browser cases plus 8 related R/Pen/text cases pass (16/16), exact discovery 3 checks and compiler inclusion/declaration 7 checks pass; focused types, lint and naming pass. Initial fixture observation errors are preserved and corrected without product edits or weaker assertions. No full local run or 101. See plan O P V T focused acceptance and tmp/tool-handoff-final.log; historical untraced failure limits remain unchanged.
